name: Roller Skates
summary: Quad roller skate boot in side view facing right, with a plate and four wheels; a hero prop for retro and sport scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the wheels touch y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 450 px wide (hero size)

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the skate faces left

author: krakujs
